researchMethod: Primary-source web search and targeted source reads on 2026-10-03, followed by direct public URL sample checks. Article wording is original. No source was treated as a license for personalized medical, legal or financial advice.
limitations: HTTP success proves source availability, not the correctness or current applicability of every instruction.
Some official sites block automated retrieval. The individual records identify failures rather than claiming every link was fetched.
No qualified medical, legal or tax professional has separately reviewed this starter library. Sensitive guide changes require editorial review before publication.
No backend deployment or daily publishing schedule is implied by this record.

keyChecks: FoodSafety.gov chart confirms poultry, including ground poultry, is 74°C/165°F; other specified ground meats are 71°C/160°F.
USDA primary-source indexed guidance confirms leftovers within 2 hours, within 1 hour above 90°F, refrigeration for 3 to 4 days and reheating to 165°F.
DOL source confirms own 401(k) contributions are vested, employer money may have a vesting schedule, and fees matter alongside risk and objectives.
CDC adult guidance confirms 150 moderate minutes or 75 vigorous minutes or an equivalent mix, with strengthening at least 2 days weekly.
NIMH current primary page supports US 988 crisis contact and 911 for life-threatening situations.
IRS guide links current free-filing eligibility rather than storing volatile dollar limits or filing deadlines.
